cli.help.short:
Commands: help [command] [-v|--verbose], mc, steam, exit
For details, try help mc -v or help steam install -v.
cli.help.short.mc:
Minecraft: mc api, mc versions, mc loaders, mc create, mc mod
Example: help mc create -v
cli.help.short.mc.api: API management: mc api list | add | remove
cli.help.short.mc.api.add: Add an API: mc api add <provider_type> ...
cli.help.short.mc.loaders: List Fabric Loader versions: mc loaders <fabric_api_id> <minecraft_version>
cli.help.short.mc.mod: Add Fabric mods: mc mod add <server_name> <source_path>
cli.help.short.steam:
Steam: steam install, steam mod add, steam mod list
Example: help steam install -v
cli.help.short.steam.install: Install a Steam server: steam install <app_id> <server_name>
cli.help.short.steam.mod: Steam mods: steam mod add or steam mod list
cli.help:
Available commands:
  help [command name]  Show detailed help (e.g. help steam install)
  mc api list
  mc api add <provider_type> <api_id> <name> <endpoint_url...>
  mc api remove <api_id>
  mc versions <api_id>
  mc create <vanilla|fabric|forge|neoforge|paper> <version> <server_name> [api_id]
  mc mod add <server_name> <source_directory>
  steam install <game> <server_name> <app_id>
  steam mod add <game> <server_name> <source_directory> [destination]
  steam mod list <game> <server_name> [destination]
  exit | quit
cli.help.minecraft:
Minecraft (mc) commands:
  mc api list
  mc api add <provider_type> <api_id> <name> <endpoint_url...>
  mc api remove <api_id>
  mc versions <api_id>
  mc loaders <fabric_api_id> <minecraft_version>
  mc create <vanilla|fabric|forge|neoforge|paper> <version> <server_name> [api_id]
  mc mod add <server_name> <source_path>
Each provider type requires its own URLs. Server creation supports vanilla, fabric, forge, neoforge, and paper. Vanilla APIs must follow Mojang's version_manifest_v2 format. See help mc api add for URL placeholders and details. Mods are copied into a Fabric server's mods/ folder.
cli.help.steam:
Steam commands:
  steam install <app_id> <server_name>
  steam install <game> <server_name> <app_id>
  steam mod add <game> <server_name> <source_path> [destination]
  steam mod list <game> <server_name> [destination]
Mod files or folders are copied from a local path. destination must be relative to the server directory.
cli.help.mc.api: Manage Minecraft APIs with mc api list, add, and remove. See help mc api add for syntax.
cli.help.mc.api.add:
Register an API:
  mc api add <provider_type> <api_id> <name> <endpoint_url...>
  vanilla <api_id> <name> <manifest_url>
  fabric <api_id> <name> <loader_url> <installer_versions_url> <installer_download_url>
  forge <api_id> <name> <promotions_url> <installer_download_url>
  neoforge <api_id> <name> <versions_url> <installer_download_url>
  paper <api_id> <name> <project_url> <version_builds_url>
api_id must be unique in the registry. Provide the required number and order of URLs for the selected provider_type. Fabric URLs use {minecraft_version} and {version}; Forge installer URLs use {minecraft_version} and {forge_version}; NeoForge installer URLs use {version}; Paper builds URLs use {minecraft_version}.
cli.help.mc.versions:
List Minecraft versions:
  mc versions <api_id>
Fetches the available versions from the selected API.
cli.help.mc.loaders:
List Fabric Loader versions:
  mc loaders <fabric_api_id> <minecraft_version>
Lists Fabric Loader versions available for the selected Minecraft version.
cli.help.mc.create:
Create a server:
  mc create <vanilla|fabric|forge|neoforge|paper> <version> <server_name> [api_id]
If api_id is omitted, vanilla uses mojang and other types use their same-named default API. Specify api_id to use a custom API. Forge and NeoForge generate launcher scripts; other types generate a server JAR launcher.
cli.help.mc.mod:
Add Fabric mods:
  mc mod add <server_name> <source_path>
Copies local mod files or folders into the server's mods/ directory.
cli.help.steam.install:
Install a Steam server:
  steam install <app_id> <server_name>
  steam install <game> <server_name> <app_id>
The short form uses the App ID as the game folder (servers/<app_id>/<server_name>). Use the three-argument form to choose a game folder name.
With login_mode = "anonymous" in config.toml, it uses anonymous login; with "account", it uses the Steam username you enter. Enter your password and Steam Guard code in SteamCMD's interactive prompts.
cli.help.steam.mod:
Manage Steam mods:
  steam mod add <game> <server_name> <source_path> [destination]
  steam mod list <game> <server_name> [destination]
See help steam mod add or help steam mod list for details.
cli.help.steam.mod.add:
Add mods:
  steam mod add <game> <server_name> <source_path> [destination]
Copies local mod files or folders into destination within the server directory.
cli.help.steam.mod.list:
List mods:
  steam mod list <game> <server_name> [destination]
Lists files at the selected destination.
